dreamteamer.title: HTTP
dreamteamer.description: dt serve: a JSON REST api at /api over a dreamteamer workspace, through the same validating store the CLI uses. Read, create, edit, reorder, revert and remove records; create and move collections and add, edit and rename fields, each behind a real compile; read history, presentation and bound commands; publish named pending writes. Loopback by default; a wider host needs a bearer token.
